d:
Official music video for original single "Look at the Lights" by Vidya Vox.
Hey guys! Here is the video for my song "Look at the Lights." It brings me back to when I was living with my mom. I had big dreams about moving to Los Angeles. Some days, I felt that I’d never be able to leave home. Other days, I was more hopeful. Making the move to Los Angeles was life changing, but once the lights went out, I still missed home. The instrumental sarangi line that echoes throughout the chorus represents a longing for home, wherever you may be.
